 Adopting the annual city budget is one of the councils most consequential responsibilities. The 2026 budget totals approximately $883 million. The process follows a predictable arc each year: the mayor proposes a budget, and between October and December the council reviews, amends, and ultimately adopts a final spending plan alongside the property tax levy . State law requires the city to hold a joint meeting with Ramsey County and the local school district in early December before the council finalizes its decisions. 4  City of Saint Paul. That changed in November 2024, when voters approved a charter amendment shifting city elections to presidential election years by a margin of about 61 percent to 39 percent. The goal is to boost voter turnout by aligning local races with the higher-profile presidential cycle. It means that Ward 2 residents will be represented by Noecker through December and then two other people over the next year or so – and that the permanent holder of the seat will likely be elected by a lower number of voters.

The City Council will review applications, interview selected candidates, and appoint an Interim Councilmember through a formal Council action. Are application materials public? Yes, all documents you submit for the position are public. Applicants must be a qualified voter of Ward 2 and will be required to show proof of residency. In addition, applicants must agree not to run for the Ward 2 office in the 2027 election. Submit a City of Saint Paul online application by 11:59 PM CST on Thursday, December 3rd, 2026.
The Saint Paul City Council is seeking applications from Ward 2 residents interested in serving as interim Councilmember following the departure of Councilmember Rebecca Noecker on December 31, 2026. The Council seeks candidates who are familiar with city government and its operations.
For more information, visit the Ward 2 website. Hiring and Position Timeline: Applications must be received by 11:59 PM CST on Thursday, December 3rd, 2026. Interviews for finalists for this position will be held in December. The City Council expects to appoint an interim Councilmember in January 2027, with the term beginning upon appointment.
